title: Persian Causative Verbs (-اندن)
explanation: Add suffix '-اندن' or '-انیدن' to the present stem of intransitive verbs to make them causative.

example_translations.ex_caus_1: The mother put the child to sleep.

common_error_explanations.err_caus_1: Use suffix '-اندن' to convert intransitive verbs into causative ones.
